title: TOEIC SW Speaking Test 15 (Bản Gốc STUDY4)

tasks.partName: Đọc to đoạn văn (Read a Text Aloud)
tasks.prompt: Read the text aloud. You will be evaluated on pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm.
tasks.textToRead: Welcome, everyone! Before we begin, in this twentieth discussion meeting, we will talk about the output of the last quarter, introduce the next sales plan and go over current issues with VIP customers. Now, look at your meeting materials. Let’s get rolling.
texts: Welcome, everyone! Before we begin, in this twentieth discussion meeting, we will talk about the output of the last quarter, introduce the next sales plan and go over current issues with VIP customers. Now, look at your meeting materials. Let’s get rolling.

Nail Lounge is celebrating summer with great deals in July. If you want to get services such as manicures, pedicures, and even neck and shoulder massage, you can get a fifty percent discount , this month only! Be sure to make an appointment, because afternoons can get a bit crowded.
scoringFocus: Ngắt nghỉ: Nghỉ ngắn ở dấu phẩy (,) và nghỉ rõ ở cuối câu (.)
Ngữ điệu câu liệt kê và câu hỏi.
Phát âm chuẩn xác các âm đuôi (-s, -ed, -tion).

tasks.partName: Miêu tả bức tranh (Describe a Picture)
tasks.prompt: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as possible.

photos.imageDescription: Miêu tả bức tranh chi tiết về bối cảnh, con người, hành động và các chi tiết phụ.
photos.sampleBand8Answer: In this photograph, we observe an active and well-illuminated setting. In the foreground, people are focused on their individual tasks while interacting productively. In the middle ground, essential tools and work materials are neatly arranged across the table. In the background, the architectural background and natural lighting establish a modern and organized atmosphere. Overall, the entire scene conveys a strong sense of teamwork and efficiency.

tasks.partName: Trả lời câu hỏi tình huống (Respond to Questions)
tasks.scenario: Imagine that a British marketing firm is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about leisure activities.

questions.question: How much leisure time do you have every day, and what do you do during that time?
questions.modelAnswer: I have about two hours of leisure time every evening, and I usually spend it reading books, listening to podcasts, or going for a run.

questions.question: What new leisure activities would you like to try if you had enough time?
questions.modelAnswer: If I had more leisure time, I would love to learn classical guitar and take up landscape photography.

questions.question: Do you prefer spending your leisure time with other people, or do you like doing things by yourself? Give specific reasons to support your opinion.
questions.modelAnswer: I enjoy a balanced combination: doing creative activities like reading alone helps me recharge, but outdoor sports and weekend road trips are always much more fun with close friends.

tasks.partName: Trả lời theo thông tin cho sẵn (Respond using Information Provided)
tasks.scenario: Bạn sẽ nhận được một lịch trình/thông tin công việc và trả lời 3 câu hỏi liên quan.
tasks.scheduleText:
Respond to questions using the information provided
Question 8: When is the Grand Opening event being held, and where?
Question 9: What time do we look around the facilities and who is leading it?
Question 10: What will Dr. Correl give a lecture about?

questions.modelAnswer: According to the provided schedule, the event is scheduled to start promptly at 9:00 A.M. in the main auditorium.

Certainly. There are two sessions scheduled in the afternoon: first, a workshop from 1:30 to 2:45 P.M., followed by a closing discussion at 3:00 P.M.

tasks.partName: Trình bày quan điểm (Express an Opinion)
tasks.prompt: Some people feel that children watch too much television these days and that this is having a negative impact. Do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
tasks.sampleBand8Answer: I firmly support this stance for two key reasons. First, this approach grants individuals significant flexibility and helps reduce daily cognitive fatigue. Second, having such balanced conditions promotes sustained motivation and superior long-term performance. Therefore, I believe this is unquestionably the most effective choice.
